vsSodiumWalkthroughDescription: Make VsSodium yours, set up a project, and tune the editor for your machine.
vsSodiumWalkthroughLookDescription:
Start with the VsSodium dark or light theme and matching file icons, then adjust the colors to your taste.
[Choose a Color Theme](command:workbench.action.selectTheme)
vsSodiumWalkthroughProfileTitle: Create a Profile for This Kind of Work
vsSodiumWalkthroughProfileDescription:
Profiles keep settings and extensions separate for different projects. Create a lightweight profile for small machines or a dedicated profile for Rust, web, or Python work.
[Open Profiles](command:workbench.profiles.actions.manageProfiles)
vsSodiumWalkthroughExtensionsTitle: Add Only the Tools You Need
vsSodiumWalkthroughExtensionsDescription:
SVG source highlighting, snippets, and a split source-preview command are built into VsSodium. Add other trusted language tools only when you need them; each extension uses some memory while active.
[Browse Extensions](command:workbench.view.extensions)
vsSodiumWalkthroughProjectDescription:
Use Source Control for Git, the integrated terminal for commands, and Tasks to save repeatable build steps. Start with a project folder so settings and tasks stay with that workspace.
[Open Source Control](command:workbench.view.scm)
vsSodiumWalkthroughPerformanceDescriptio:
Check the Process Explorer and Running Extensions before changing settings. Disable extensions you do not use, and exclude generated folders from file watching only when your project does not need live updates.
[Open Process Explorer](command:workbench.action.openProcessExplorer)
vsSodiumWalkthroughBackupDescription:
Use Profiles to export and import settings and extensions. Settings Sync can keep your setup across devices; avoid syncing secrets or machine-specific paths.
[Open Settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings)
vsSodiumWalkthroughHelpDescription:
Open logs and the issue reporter when something fails. Include steps to reproduce and relevant logs, and remove private information before sharing.
[Report an Issue](command:workbench.action.openIssueReporter)
